items.title: World’s largest crypto exchange hit by world’s largest heist

items.title: Protests and violence now go hand in hand in France. It wasn’t always like this
items.brief: Lucas Petit was just 11 when hundreds of thousands of men and women wearing yellow vests poured onto the streets and occupied roundabouts across France in November 2018.

items.title: 3 dead after 2 helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport, sheriff says
items.brief: Investigators were combing through debris scattered across a field in northwest Oregon Thursday after two helicopters collided midair, killing three people and forcing the closure of a nearby highway, officials said.
